hook: Hide Eggs on your opponent's biggest units; when the clock strikes, Chicks fed on their stats turn on them.
loop: Place Layers across from big enemies, leaving empty slots as nest boxes.
Brood grows permanently, so every Chick hatches bigger each turn.
At the Hour, Chicks hatch from host stats and shove their hosts.

growth.line: Chicks take a quarter of enemy hosts plus Brood, rising each turn; sleepers grow permanently each Hour.

feel.early: Thin: tiny Chicks off small hosts, dormice carry.
feel.mid: Brood climbs; scout hosts, pick holes, sleep a carry.
feel.late: Gernegroß, Kasimir and Old Unruh feast on tall boards.

stars.why: Hides on the biggest enemy and returns with its stats.
Eats your own Chick for permanent stats.
Sleeps any tribe's carry through the opening trades.

card_short.u01: Lays an Egg across; its Chick hatches a bit bigger.
card_short.u02: Asleep through the opening; wakes with a fight buff.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: Brood grows permanently.
card_short.u04: Sleeps the biggest unit next to it; it wakes buffed.
card_short.u05: Gold next turn when the Hour strikes; more on third.
card_short.u06: Lays on top-Attack enemy; your Eggs hatch when hosts die.
card_short.u07: Wind 2: the first Hour strikes sooner.
card_short.u08: On the Hour: your Asleep units grow permanently, twice.
card_short.u09: On the Hour: lays an Egg on a random enemy.
card_short.u10: Each Chick hatching grows Brood permanently, twice a fight.
card_short.u11: Eats a Chick beside it for permanent stats.
card_short.u12: Lays an Egg on every enemy back-row unit.
card_short.u13: After a hatch, Discover from the host's tribe.
card_short.u14: Delays Start of Combat effects to the Hour, doubled.
card_short.u15: Hides as an Egg on the biggest enemy; returns huge.
card_short.u16: Also a Bird; Chick share rises from quarter to half.
card_short.u17: The Hour strikes every 2 attacks, not 4.
card_short.u18: Lays an Egg on every enemy.
card_short.u19: Sleeps all fight, growing each Hour; the alarm wakes him.
card_short.x01: Fight-only token: Egg stats plus Brood; adds no hero damage.

builds.name: The Brood
builds.line: Eggs wide with Brood buffs; leave nest boxes, punish tall boards.

builds.name: The Sleeping Vault
builds.line: Sleep another tribe's carry beside a Warden; it wakes bigger.

builds.name: Clockwork
builds.line: Wind and the Tower speed the clock; Ottilie doubles Start of Combat.

liked: All three: only tribe playing on the enemy's board, feeding on its size.
Little Gernegroß hiding in the biggest enemy and returning huge; Nest-Box eating Chicks.
worries: Watch: golden Hour-Keeper (every attack) with Door Cuckoo makes many Eggs; needs a sim.
Watch golden Rohrsang, Ottilie and Herald; Ottilie's text still reads two ways.
changed: Fledgling's Chick hatches bigger, so the Egg side shows from turn 1.
Timing spelled out for Ottilie, Gernegroß and Wind; enemies' targeting now skips sleepers.
Herald pays a second gold when the Hour strikes three times.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; second of three Cuckoo designs, steadier but lower-peaking; for players who scout and punish tall boards.
